merge into T_XWYY_MACHINE_ROLL_MAPPING a USING (
select #{MACHINE.bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BIG_ROLL_CODE, #{MACHINE.machineId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} MACHINE_ID,
#{MACHINE.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{MACHINE.createTime,jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{MACHINE.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{MACHINE.updateTime,jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{MACHINE.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark from dual
) b ON (a.BIG_ROLL_CODE = b.BIG_ROLL_CODE and a.MACHINE_ID = b.MACHINE_ID and a.del_flag = '0') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = sysdate, a.remark = b.remark WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( a.id , a.BIG_ROLL_CODE, a.MACHINE_ID,
a.create_by , a.create_time , a.remark, a.del_flag ) values (SEQ_PUBLIC.NEXTVAL, b.BIG_ROLL_CODE, b.MACHINE_ID, b.create_by, sysdate, b.remark, '0' )
